answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol deploys an atlas of identity graphs paired with quadratic stake burning. Each registered agent must deposit an unrecoverable bond scaled superlinearly by O(N^2) against cluster density, turning the network into a financial canyon that swallows forged identities. A verifiable lantern beacon anchors cryptographic proof-of-burn checkpoints, imposing prohibitive exponential economic friction on attackers.
